audience: managers and HR teams that plan shifts, track time and approve time off in Findmyshift

useCases.title: See who is clocked in now
useCases.text: List the teams this key can see. Then check who is clocked in right now, for a team or one staff member.

useCases.title: Review planned shifts and worked hours
useCases.text: Read shifts per staff member or per day, with times and facilities. Read worked hours instead of planned shifts when you need them.

useCases.title: Compare schedules with timesheets
useCases.text: Compare the planned schedule with the recorded timesheets for a date range. Read the time clock entries for the same period.

useCases.title: Review time off requests
useCases.text: List time off records for one staff member or a date range. Open one record to see its approval state.

useCases.title: Approve or unapprove time off
useCases.text: Approve one time off record, so staff see it as approved. Remove the approval from the same record if needed.

useCases.title: Clock staff in or out
useCases.text: Clock a staff member in or out now, for payroll time. Photos and locations are not sent.
